title: TrackingEvent
description: The shape of an event passed to global_tracker.track(). Currently the Node @tracking decorator calls track(key, latency_ms, is_error) positionally; this schema describes the equivalent record for parity tests and downstream consumers.

key.description: ClassName.methodName for class methods; just methodName for free functions.

latency_ms.description: Wall-clock latency in milliseconds, rounded down.

is_error.description: True iff the wrapped call raised/threw.

ts.description: Optional epoch-ms timestamp of when the event was recorded. Both implementations should populate this in v2.0.0.
